scope: Read-only pre-output review of frozen frontend sensitivity ablation; no model/frontend construction or inference by reviewer.
findings: Original model, tokenizer, native decoder, input arrays, source criteria, thread counts, attempts, initialization and resource budgets are unchanged by exact plan comparison.
The helper completes normal model construction and replaces only the uncalled NumPy frontend with the pinned model-supplied ONNX frontend; raw features are freshly computed and returned unchanged.

Each actual feature tensor is checked against the pinned matching retained ONNX pair at the same declared tolerance and exact shape/valid-length requirement; retained features are not substituted as inputs.
The changed frontend is explicitly logged and its session captured once; the existing full-array and raw-token/timestamp observer remains in place.
The comparator uses the one-thread parity outputs while this ablation preserves four recognition threads; any tolerated numerical difference is explicitly recorded.
The unchanged original semantic criteria remain authoritative. A different transcript would be frontend sensitivity evidence, not proof that the older frontend is correct.
decision: No material pre-output contract blocker found. Authorized single diagnostic may proceed only after the shared model slot is released. No adoption, accuracy or ground-truth preference approved.
